page_summary: These pages outline various astrological combinations (yogas) used to determine an individual's longevity class, specifically focusing on indicators for a middle life span (Madhyamayu) and a long life span (Purnayu). General principles for assessing house strength, which influences longevity, are also provided. The text details specific planetary placements and aspects that suggest particular life span ranges.
